about.title: About Cross Construction Services
text: We have over 30 years of experience in concrete construction for concrete driveways and patios. We’re a family-owned business serving Houston, Texas and surrounding areas. Our team is led by experts in the concrete construction business.

We are available 24 hours a day, 7 days a week to help you solve your concrete needs. We have a simple philosophy – Solve a customer’s concrete problem with a simple, straightforward, economical solution.

Since 1993, Cross Construction Services has transformed Houston homes with beautiful, durable concrete driveways, patios, and pergolas. Our family-owned business is built on integrity and a passion for exceeding expectations. From classic concrete to stylish stamped and stained finishes, we pave the way for lasting impressions. Create your outdoor oasis with custom concrete patios, shady pergolas, and sleek aluminum covers. We also specialize in multi-family parking lots, decorative pavers, flagstones, and travertine for commercial projects.
